POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.

PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory within the persistent volume. Do not change on an existing database.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Generated private Redis/Valkey password, or a reference to that password. Keep secret.

REDIS_URL.description: Private authenticated Redis/Valkey connection URL. Automatically assembled from service references.

DEBUG.description: Debug for bookwyrm. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DOMAIN.description: Domain resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

SECRET_KEY.description: Generated secret key. Keep private and preserve with backups.

POSTGRES_HOST.description: Private PostgreSQL hostname. Automatically resolved from the postgres service.

POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.

PGPORT.description: Pgport for bookwyrm. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

REDIS_ACTIVITY_URL.description: Redis activity url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

REDIS_BROKER_URL.description: Redis broker url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

STATIC_ROOT.description: Static root for bookwyrm. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

MEDIA_ROOT.description: Media root for bookwyrm. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

EMAIL_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname. Leave empty to disable outbound email; set a real host for invitations and password resets.

EMAIL_PORT.description: Email port for bookwyrm. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

EMAIL_HOST_USER.description: SMTP username. Required only when EMAIL_HOST is configured.

EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD.description: SMTP password. Required only when EMAIL_HOST is configured.

EMAIL_USE_TLS.description: Email use tls for bookwyrm. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

EMAIL_USE_SSL.description: Email use ssl for bookwyrm. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

UPLOAD_IMAGE_DIMENSIONS.description: Upload image dimensions for bookwyrm. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
